description: The line plot illustrates the validation performance of the SimSMoE model over the course of training, measured by the Bits Per Character (BPC) metric on the y-axis against Training Steps (scaled by ×10³) on the x-axis. The x-axis spans from 0 to 50 (×10³), with major tick marks at intervals of 10, indicating training progress in tens of thousands of steps. The y-axis ranges from 1.1 to 2.2 BPC, with tick marks at 0.1 intervals, showing the model’s decreasing loss or increasing efficiency as training progresses. Two lines are plotted: a black line with downward-pointing triangle markers and a magenta line with star markers, both labeled in the legend as “SimSMoE Validating.” The magenta line starts at approximately 2.15 BPC at 0 steps, drops sharply to around 1.5 BPC by 5×10³ steps, then gradually declines to approximately 1.15 BPC by 50×10³ steps. The black line follows a nearly identical trajectory, starting at 2.15 BPC, dipping to 1.5 BPC by 5×10³ steps, and stabilizing near 1.15 BPC after 20×10³ steps, with minor fluctuations thereafter. Both lines exhibit a steep initial decline followed by a slow convergence, suggesting rapid early learning and later stabilization of performance. A gray rectangular box appears in the upper right of the plot, likely indicating a region of interest or a shaded area for emphasis, though it does not correspond to any labeled data series.
